name: browser
description: DEPRECATED — the browser plugin now ships from its own repository, https://github.com/5dive-ai/5dive-browser (`sudo 5dive plugin add 5dive-ai/5dive-browser`). This copy still resolves and still installs, because boxes provisioned before the move name it today — but it is frozen and receives no fixes. Migrate: `sudo 5dive plugin remove browser@5dive-plugins`, then the add above — in that order, because the CLI refuses two plugins claiming the `browser` verb. The new repository is AHEAD of this copy and is where fixes land: at 1.10.2 the two carry the same `served`/`forget` verbs, but this copy does NOT carry DIVE-4794's probe fix, which shipped only there. The version numbers are aligned so that the box converger can require one floor across both copies; they are not a promise of identical bytes. See CHANGES.md. Persistent human-authenticated browser sessions — log into a site once by hand, then let deterministic adapters operate it. Never solves a security challenge; it stops and asks you.

verbs.name: browser

setup.hint: browser needs a root-created profile store that 5dive will not create behind your back, and a Chrome on the box.
